title: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4, dubbed "le Chonk", a 1T-parameter open-weight model for general agentic capabilities, trained on 4,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwells (Sabrina Ortiz/The Deep View)
summary: Sabrina Ortiz / The Deep View: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4, dubbed “le Chonk”, a 1T-parameter open-weight model for general agentic capabilities, trained on 4,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwells — Most flagship models dominating the market are from frontier labs and are closed models.
